verify.why: The dense wooden architecture represents intended environmental clutter and stylization rather than a navigation defect.

refuted.where: orange block light fixture on the side of the building
refuted.desc: The orange light block is floating off the side of the wall without any visible mounting bracket or connection.

verify.why: The orange fixture is attached to the building wall with visible mounting hardware.

refuted.where: top-left end of the flag banner line
refuted.desc: The decorative banner string attaches to an arbitrary point in mid-air rather than a wooden post or wall fixture.

verify.why: The banner string connects directly to the wooden beam structure on the left.

refuted.where: wooden stairs in the upper right background
refuted.desc: The staircase leads straight up to the cliff face with no clear doorway, ledge, or visible continuation.

verify.why: The upper staircase leads directly to a wooden platform with stalls, barrels, and a continuing walkway rather than ending at a blank cliff face.

refuted.where: staircase on the upper right cliff face
refuted.desc: The wooden steps float above the cliff side without structural supports anchoring them into the terrain.

verify.why: The wooden staircase is visibly supported from below by thick wooden posts and beams connecting it to the terrain.

refuted.where: row of orange cubes floating in mid-air on the left
refuted.desc: A horizontal line of untextured orange cubes floats in mid-air without ropes or structural support.

verify.why: The orange blocks are supported by a wooden beam beneath them rather than floating unsupported in mid-air.

refuted.where: row of orange blocks on the left
refuted.desc: A series of bright orange block steps float horizontally in mid-air without visible structural supports or ropes.

verify.why: The orange blocks rest on a narrow horizontal wooden beam rather than floating in mid-air.

refuted.where: row of orange blocks on the left
refuted.desc: A row of orange rectangular blocks floats suspended in mid-air near the building without any visible support or string.

verify.why: The blocks are positioned directly on top of a horizontal wooden rail.

refuted.where: row of orange blocks on the left
refuted.desc: A horizontal sequence of bright orange cubic blocks floats in mid-air without visible structural supports.

verify.why: A wooden beam clearly supports the row of orange blocks underneath.

refuted.where: dark shadow region behind central roof
refuted.desc: A harsh, completely black shadow conceals the terrain and structures behind the central wooden roof.

verify.why: The area behind the central roof is lit and clearly shows the cliff face and timber structures, not a total black shadow.

refuted.where: row of floating orange blocks left of center
refuted.desc: A series of orange square blocks float in mid-air without any supporting structure.

verify.why: The blocks rest on a wooden pole extending from the building.

refuted.where: long ladder on the right cliff side
refuted.desc: The ladder hovers unsupported off the rocky cliff face without visible mounting points or anchoring.

verify.why: The ladder is slanted between the lower structure and upper platform as a standard leaning ladder rather than hovering in space.

refuted.where: row of orange boxes floating in mid-air near the house
refuted.desc: A row of small orange cubic blocks floats in mid-air without any visible rope, beam, or support.

verify.why: A visible wooden beam supports the row of orange blocks.

refuted.where: row of orange cubes hanging in the mid-left
refuted.desc: The bright orange cubes float along the thin beam without visible hooks or attachment fixtures.

verify.why: Objects resting on a flat wooden beam do not require special hooks or attachment fixtures.

refuted.where: floating orange cubes across the gap near the hut
refuted.desc: A row of bright orange cubes floats in mid-air across the gap without any supporting structure.

verify.why: The orange cubes sit on top of a wooden beam spanning out from the structure.

refuted.where: row of orange cubes near the middle left
refuted.desc: A row of bright orange blocks floats in mid-air without structural support or context, breaking scene belief.

verify.why: The orange blocks are resting on a wooden beam rather than floating freely without support.

refuted.where: middle center dock walkway
refuted.desc: A white cylinder light fixture floats in mid-air above the dock structure without any support or mount.

verify.why: The white light fixture on the central dock walkway rests directly on the wooden deck surface rather than floating.

refuted.where: top-right background near mountain ridge
refuted.desc: The background mountain mesh terminates prematurely, revealing the empty background void.

verify.why: The mountain wall in the top-right background continues fully off-screen without exposing any empty void.

refuted.where: right end of the main boardwalk
refuted.desc: The primary wooden boardwalk terminates abruptly mid-air over the water with no stairs, ladder, or clear way forward.

verify.why: The boardwalk properly terminates on supporting wooden pilings near the shore structure as part of the dock boundary.

refuted.where: dark shadowed recess underneath the cliff overhang in center background
refuted.desc: Extremely heavy shadow obscures the interior space beneath the upper buildings, making it impossible to see if there is walkable ground or an path.

verify.why: Heavy shadowing under stilted cliffside structures is standard environmental lighting and does not obscure playable pathways.

examples.desc: The large rocky ridge occludes the ground connection between the upper path and the lower dock area, making the transition route between them hard to read from this camera angle.
examples.why: Natural terrain occluding lower elevation areas from an elevated overview camera angle is standard level design.
